_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Spot coil keeps the Complacency rung; unresolved crowded-long/skew/netflow extremes block a skilled upgrade until they cool or break.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency low conviction; narrative silent on forward phase and only supplies flow facts
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound, long/short and skew extremes cool without spot breakdown, F&G holds ~45-55
next_move.invalidated_if: spot breaks range down with ETF flows near zero and elevated exchange inflows (Anxiety), or up on sharp ETF-flow reversal with CVD positive (Disbelief)
